Ever want to be a starship trooper? Like mining?

Easy to pick up and play, better with friends.

Video review at bottom if that's more your thing.

   Deep Rock Galactic has you playing as dwarves working for the Deep Rock Galactic Corporation gathering minerals and hunting dangerous alien lifeforms, known as Glyphids, on the planet of Hoxxes IV.
Missions are chosen from the Space Rig which serves as the hub for the multiplayer lobby. The missions are broken up into objectives as well as locations. Each mission is procedurally generated based on the area of Hoxxes IV that was chosen. Though each mission objective varies slightly a nutshell description would be that once you land on the planet you are to find your objective in vast dark tunnels with no natural light using your flares as well as the weapons and abilities of your chosen class.
   There are 4 classes to choose from. First up is the Driller who can dig much faster than the other classes thanks to his reinforced titanium power drills. For combat he carries a flamethrower and pistol. Just in case those can’t get the job done he comes equipped with satchel charges as well. Next we have the engineer who first and foremost deploys turrets to protect his team from the swarms of glyphids that are prone to descending upon any who visit Hoxxes IV. He also carries a shotgun, grenade launcher as well as a platform gun that can shoot platforms into any terrain. Then there is the gunner. His top priority will be to mow down hordes of aliens with his powerful minigun. He also carries a heavy caliber revolver for a sidearm and can deploy shields to protect his team or ziplines to help them cross ravines or get up to ledges. Lastly is the scout. He has the highest mobility thanks to his grappling hook so he can check out areas before the rest of his team use their limited ziplines or platforms to get everyone there and a flare gun to provide much more light than the standard hand thrown flares. For combat he’s equipped with an assault rifle and double barrel shotgun. All the classes carry the hand thrown flares I just mentioned along with a standard pickaxe. Though it doesn’t come close to the drillers digging speed. Each class also has several unique throwables to choose from.
   After you finish a mission you will earn XP that will level up the class you were playing. Leveling up unlocks upgrade slots you can purchase which allow you to customize and beef up the dwarves.
  Obviously being a co-op shooter of sorts it shines playing with a few friends, but thanks to the little upgradeable drone BOSCO it is even quite enjoyable solo.
